subject: general
question: Which of the following classical dance forms is known for storytelling through facial expressions and hand gestures, and comes from Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the **oldest classical dance forms of India** and originates from the state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is known for its **expressive storytelling** through a combination of intricate **hand gestures (mudras)**, facial expressions, and rhythmic footwork.
 
• This dance form was traditionally performed in temples as a form of **devotional offering** to the deities, reflectin
